objective: Implement the World Model-owned persistence slice of Issue #56: validate ActionResult-carrying Motion ExecutionEvents, atomically persist contract-valid WorldEvents, and return stable resolvable evidence references without modifying Motion or shared contracts.
decision_supported: Can Motion action-result evidence be durably persisted and resolved using only the existing Motion and shared-contract boundaries?
acceptance: test_valid_action_result_maps_to_world_event proves that an ExecutionEvent with event_type action_result and a payload accepted by the existing ActionResult model maps to a contract-valid WorldEvent without mutating the source event.

The mapped WorldEvent uses event_id motion-result:{run_id}:{result_id}, run_id from ActionResult, event_type action_result, occurred_at from ActionResult.ended_at, the normalized ActionResult payload, and ActionResult.evidence_refs.
test_stable_reference_resolves_exact_event proves that append returns world-event:{event_id} only after durable commit and that World Model lookup resolves it to exactly the stored WorldEvent.

test_invalid_execution_event_fails_before_write proves that node_started, an invalid ActionResult payload, a mismatched run_id, and a mismatched action_id are rejected before any database row is written.
test_identical_retry_is_idempotent proves that re-appending the same normalized ActionResult identity and content returns the same stable reference and leaves exactly one stored row.

test_conflicting_result_retry_preserves_original proves that reusing the same deterministic event identity with different normalized content raises a typed integrity error and preserves the original event.

test_allocated_sequence_follows_run_maximum and test_allocated_sequence_is_per_run prove that the store allocates sequence numbers inside the SQLite transaction, starts an empty run at one, follows the persisted per-run maximum, and keeps separate runs independent.

test_concurrent_allocated_appends_are_race_safe proves that separate SQLite connections concurrently appending different action results to the same run both succeed with distinct consecutive sequence numbers and deterministic replay order.

test_append_uses_detached_serializable_snapshot proves that the adapter consumes ExecutionEvent.as_serializable(), persists a strict-JSON-compatible detached snapshot, and does not mutate or retain mutable aliases to the source payload.

test_persistence_failures_propagate_without_reference proves that serialization failure, transaction failure, and store outage propagate to the caller without returning a reference, inserting a row, or falling back to FakeEvidenceSink.
test_reopen_preserves_evidence_reference proves that closing and reopening SQLite preserves the event and that the original stable reference still resolves to it.
test_motion_append_store_replay_and_lookup uses the actual read-only workbench_motion.evidence.ExecutionEvent and proves append through the adapter, ordered store replay, and evidence lookup.
test_adapter_import_does_not_require_motion_package proves that importing the World Model adapter does not require workbench_motion to be installed in the root Python package.
This Task Packet does not modify scaffold_node.py, select a production Motion sink, persist node_started, or claim that production Motion wiring is complete.

Implementation requires changing robot/control/**, wiring scaffold_node.py, selecting a production Motion sink, or altering FakeEvidenceSink.
Implementation requires persisting node_started or mapping node_started to action_result.
Implementation requires changing firmware, simulation, hardware, kernel, deployment or safety configuration.

Implementation requires changing pyproject.toml, Makefile, package installation metadata, CI or build configuration.

ActionResult identity, evidence_refs, ended_at or run/action correlation cannot be mapped using the existing contracts.

The branch merge base differs from 1044c843a13cca5606d1f0dc58381d3f5d713267 before implementation begins.
Any required modification falls outside allowed_paths.

risks_and_fallbacks: This Packet completes only the World Model-owned persistence slice; production Motion injection remains separate work requiring Motion and Integration approval.

The root Python project does not install workbench_motion, so the adapter uses structural append and as_serializable compatibility while the integration test explicitly loads the read-only Motion source package.
The first automatically allocated sequence number is one, following existing World Model tests; if a different repository-wide convention is required, stop rather than changing shared contracts.
If SQLite cannot provide the required concurrency guarantee without migration or global configuration changes, stop and return the failing concurrency evidence.
